messages:
fran (eng-ml): Quick proposal: introduce an "admission escrow" concept for onboarding. escrow = short-lived token + immutable provenance bundle that allows immediate revoke + audit trail. Purpose: fast revoke if post-route regressions appear.

yang (eng-platform): Interesting. So admission responds with escrow_token and run_id? API sketch: kickoff -> run_id + escrow_token + initial_state. escrow_token redeems to remove model from routing.

beau (eng-sre): Requirements: escrow redemption must be fast-path and global (no eventual consistency delays). Also track escrow redemptions in audit logs and alert if redemption rate > 0 (indicates trouble).

lina (product): Customers will want to know how that affects availability. Can we promise a window: "usable after microbench; escrow active for 24h by default"?

fran (eng-ml): Proposal: stages: 0=fingerprint, 1=microbench (fast latency/cost), 2=canary (1% traffic), 3=deep-eval. Admission grants usable=true after stage1 with escrow active for configurable TTL.

harry (qa): QA asks: escrow must reference replay artifact + seedset so we can reproduce regressions for triage. Also include a canonical diff payload.

fran (eng-ml): yes — escrow payload includes: run_id, provenance_uri, seed_list_uri, last_successful_artifact_id. Also store a small sample of golden outputs (hashes).

yang (eng-platform): console changes: show escrow status, redeem button (with 2FA for prod), and run timeline. Also emit events: escrow_created, escrow_redeemed.

beau (eng-sre): Operational: auto-redeem rule proposals: error_rate > 0.5% sustained 10m OR quality_delta > threshold on production signals. But auto-redeem should be conservative; prefer alert + suggested-redeem unless severe.

lina (product): For private deployments, tenancy may want escrow disabled or extended TTL. Add per-tenant policy and documented expectations.

fran (eng-ml): Fallbacks: if a model fails post-route, platform should support two fallbacks: 1) route to pinned older model version; 2) route to a safe runtime variant (more conservative kernel/quant). Fallback chosen by policy in descriptor or org defaults.

yang (eng-platform): Descriptor fields: {"run_id","escrow_token","fallback_policy":["pin_version","runtime_variant"],"canary_percent","canary_duration_mins","provenance_uri","seeds_uri"}. Will add immutable run_id.

harry (qa): For triage ease: attach reproduce.sh in provenance bundle and a minimal dataset of 20 stratified prompts used for quick repro. Include expected output hashes.

beau (eng-sre): Alerting: page if pinned-fallback fails for >5m or if repeated escrow redemptions within 24h for same tenant. Track global fallback usage metric.

deploy-bot: kickoff acknowledged: onboard/escrow/3487654321 queued on smoke-pool

fran (eng-ml): Next steps: I'll draft RFC with admission escrow schema, redemption semantics, fallback policy examples, and runbook for auto vs manual redemption. Owners: fran (design), yang (platform/console), beau (SRE/alerts), harry (QA reproducibility).

lina (product): Please include customer UX language and recommended default TTL (24h) + enterprise override flow. Also include how this interacts with Dedicated and Private deployments.

yang (eng-platform): I'll prototype status API and escrow redemption endpoint. Will add audit-event plumbing.

fran (eng-ml): Thanks — aim to post RFC this afternoon. Short-term: choose a default escrow_ttl=24h, canary_percent=1%, canary_duration=120m.

beau (eng-sre): One more: ensure redemption honors region routing; redemption must remove all regional routes within 30s. Add that to runbook.

harry (qa): And I'll prepare the minimal stratified seedset and reproduce template once RFC lands.

fran (eng-ml): Great. End of thread.
